trace_name: Bailout run — Critical View unobtainable, fenestrating subtotal

safety_gate.note: the Critical View was unobtainable in this scenario and the guideline bailout pathway was taken; gate points measure gate achievement only and are not the bailout's grade

the triangle cannot be cleared: dense inflammatory fusion at the gallbladder neck; the Critical View criteria cannot be demonstrated
dp2 -> subtotal-fenestrating
bailout branch replaces the division-path requirements
m6b.1: Open the gallbladder at the fundus and evacuate bile
m6b.2: Extract all stones from the gallbladder lumen
m6b.3: Excise the free peritonealised gallbladder wall, leaving the portion shielding the hepatocystic triangle in place
m6b.4: Close the cystic duct orifice from inside the remnant (purse-string suture)
m6b.5: Confirm the fenestrating configuration: remnant left open with no sealed lumen (for the reconstituting choice at dp2, the remnant is instead closed and the reformation caveat applies)
m6b.6: Place a drain to the gallbladder fossa
m8.1: Place the gallbladder in a retrieval bag
m8.2: Extract the bagged gallbladder via the umbilical port
m8.3: Desufflate under vision and remove all ports
m8.4: Close the fascia at the umbilical 10 mm site
m8.5: Close the fascia at the epigastric 10 mm site
m8.6: Close the skin
m8.7: WHO Sign Out completed before the patient leaves the operating room
